name: Tiurana (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged with two keys in saltire, yellow and white, with their wards upward and outward, above a chequy stripe of yellow and black along the lower edge.
history: The official flag of Tiurana is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the keys of the arms with their wards upward and facing outward, in saltire, the yellow in bend and the white in bend sinister, the whole 9/16 of the height of the cloth; approved by the municipal council on 28 March 2001 and published in the DOGC on 10 October 2002. It is based on the heraldic arms of the town.

features.role: chequy stripe along the lower edge
